name: get_metadata
description: Extract metadata from any URL to preview page content. Returns title, description, image, author, publisher, logo, and structured data—useful when you need to understand a webpage without visiting it directly.

url.description: The URL to extract metadata from.

name: take_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of any webpage. Returns image URL showing the rendered page layout and visual content—use to verify page state or design.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to screenshot.
